# Antigravity Design System — Full Reference Manual

> An agent-native, human-centric design system standard built for high visual precision, physical intuition, and robust software engineering.

## 1. Core Manifesto & Invariants

1. Physical Yield on pointerdown: Interactive surfaces compress (scale 0.97 to 0.98) on touch or pointer down. Never wait for pointer release.
2. Zero Layout Shifts: Never change border-width, font-weight, letter-spacing, margin, or padding across any dynamic state. Always declare transparent borders on resting states.
3. Tabular Numerals: All counters, prices, dates, and metrics declare font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums (tabular-nums).
4. Accessible Invariants: Every icon-only button possesses an explicit aria-label. Dialogues trap focus and dismiss on Escape.
5. Quiet Chrome: Avoid bordered cards reflexively. Let typography, spatial rhythm, and baseline alignment carry visual hierarchy. No decorative eyebrow pill badges above titles.
6. Concentric Corner Radii: Compute inner radius mathematically: R_inner = max(0, R_outer - Padding).
7. Anti-Crush Responsive Page Architecture: Layout columns guarantee minimum viable widths (>= 340px). Status badges declare shrink-0 and whitespace-nowrap.
8. Reversible Kinetic Affordances: Icons only animate when possessing a mechanical affordance that glides back to resting origin. No spinning operational icons or vanishing glyphs.
9. Component Dimension Invariants: Never merge multi-axis utility shorthands (size-full, p-0) after single-axis dimensions (h-9, px-4) in cn().
10. Component-Unified Kinetic Affinity: Nested icons react synchronously with parent button or card hover/press lifecycle. Icons maintain optical ratios between 40% and 50% of parent container height.
11. Perceptual OKLCH Gradient Engineering: Linear gradients interpolate in modern perceptual color spaces (in oklch). Text text-contrast achieves WCAG 2.2 AA (>= 4.5:1) and WCAG 3 APCA (|Lc| >= 60).
12. British English: Prose, comments, documentation, and tooltips strictly use British English spelling. No em dashes in text.
13. Origin Anonymity: All standards, tokens, and components are presented as self-contained standards of this design system.
14. Telemetry Indicator Cadence: Pulsing indicators maintain >= 60% resting window between impulses and animate exclusively compositor properties (transform, opacity).

## 2. Token Architecture

### Perceptual OKLCH Color Engine
- Background: `oklch(0.99 0.002 240)` (light) / `oklch(0.14 0.005 260)` (dark)
- Foreground: `oklch(0.18 0.005 260)` (light) / `oklch(0.98 0.002 240)` (dark)
- Primary: `oklch(0.20 0.01 260)` (light) / `oklch(0.98 0.005 240)` (dark)
- Primary Foreground: `oklch(0.99 0.002 240)` (light) / `oklch(0.14 0.01 260)` (dark)
- Accent: `oklch(0.96 0.005 260)` (light) / `oklch(0.22 0.008 260)` (dark)
- Border: `oklch(0.88 0.005 260)` (light) / `oklch(0.28 0.008 260)` (dark)
- Destructive: `oklch(0.55 0.22 25)`
- Success: `oklch(0.62 0.18 145)`
- Warning: `oklch(0.75 0.16 75)`

### Fluid Motion Springs
- Tactile: `{ type: "spring", stiffness: 600, damping: 30, mass: 0.8 }`
- Dialog: `{ type: "spring", stiffness: 350, damping: 35, mass: 1.0 }`
- Snappy: `{ type: "spring", stiffness: 550, damping: 35, mass: 0.6 }`
- Micro: `{ type: "spring", stiffness: 700, damping: 40 }`
- Squishy: `{ type: "spring", stiffness: 420, damping: 24, mass: 0.8 }`

### Liquid Glass Shaders
- Ultra-Thin: `backdrop-filter: blur(28px)`, 55% alpha
- Thin: `backdrop-filter: blur(20px)`, 70% alpha
- Regular: `backdrop-filter: blur(16px)`, 82% alpha
- Thick: `backdrop-filter: blur(12px)`, 92% alpha

## 3. Component Usage Guide

Import primitives from `@/components/ui`:
```tsx
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { SparklesIcon } from "@/components/icons";

export function ExampleCard() {
  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <CardTitle>Autonomous Cluster</CardTitle>
          <Badge variant="success" dot>Active</Badge>
        </div>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <Button variant="default" leftIcon={<SparklesIcon size={16} />}>
          Execute Deployment
        </Button>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```
